events.body: DL-3011 is held at import for clearance. Declared: one used camera lens, value 640. To clear it I need from the importer: (1) commercial invoice, (2) the importer's EORI number. Upload on the Broker portal against DL-3011. Storage is free until 2027-05-25.

Your lens, DL-3011, is held for import clearance. The customs broker asks for two things, uploaded on the Broker portal against DL-3011: a commercial invoice, and the importer's EORI number. Storage is free until 2027-05-25.
Uploaded the invoice. Well, it's the seller's payment receipt and his email with the price on, that's all there is, it was a private sale off a forum. What's an EORI?

On DL-3011: the recipient says this was a private purchase from an individual, so there is no commercial invoice; he has uploaded the seller's payment receipt and an email stating the price. He does not hold an EORI number. Please confirm what you need from a private buyer.
I've asked the broker to confirm what applies to a private buyer and whether what you uploaded is enough. I'll come back to you when she answers.
been on the gov site an hour trying to get this EORI thing, it wants company or sole trader details. Do I just put myself down as a sole trader??

Correcting my request on DL-3011, I had it keyed as a business import. Private individual: no EORI, and he should not register for one for this. The receipt and seller email he uploaded are accepted in place of a commercial invoice. Still outstanding, two things: a signed personal-use declaration (form PU-1, the template is on the portal under DL-3011) and a copy of photo ID matching the consignee name, both uploaded there. Then I can lodge the entry. Duty and VAT are assessed after lodging and Import billing sends the charge; I can't give a figure.

Right I've half filled in the sole trader form for the EORI. It's asking for a business start date, what do I put? And roughly how much is the import bill going to be, seller said there'd be nothing to pay.

Label scan attached for reference: label-scan-942.txt
